data.name: Start_Lead
data.value: Handle your city's administrative services online – appointments, applications and reports in one place. You sign in securely with BundID.

data.name: Start_LoginText
data.value: Sign in with your BundID. Your Citizen Portal account is created automatically the first time.

data.name: Start_WhatIsBundId
data.value: BundID is the central user account for online administrative services in Germany. Here, a BundID simulator with fictitious test persons takes its place. More about the real BundID:

data.name: Start_ServicesNote
data.value: All services are available after signing in with BundID.

data.name: Service_Appointments_Text
data.value: Book consultation appointments at the citizens' office, change the location or cancel them.

data.name: Service_Passport_Text
data.value: Prepare and submit your application online – this requires the level “substantial”, e.g. with an ELSTER certificate or the online ID.

data.name: Service_BulkyWaste_Text
data.value: Register a bulky waste collection on a preferred day.

data.name: Service_Issues_Text
data.value: Report damage in the city, such as potholes or broken street lights.

data.name: Service_Discover_Text
data.value: City map, locations of the citizens' offices and city news.

data.name: Service_Mailbox_Text
data.value: You receive confirmations for appointments and applications in your BundID mailbox.

data.name: Service_MyData_Text
data.value: See at any time which details BundID transmitted and what the portal stores.

data.name: Start_SessionExpired_Text
data.value: For your security you were signed out automatically – after 30 minutes without activity or at the latest 8 hours after signing in. Please sign in again with your BundID.
